blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. has ordered an investigation into reports that some Filipino athletes, particularly members of the Alas Pilipinas men’s volleyball team, had to pay out of pocket for food during the ongoing Asian Games in Japan. Palace press officer Claire Castro said Marcos does not want Filipino athletes representing the country to struggle because the government is failing to respond to their needs. “First and foremost, this will be investigated so we can determine what our athletes and players actually experienced,” Castro said in a briefing on Monday. “The president does not want those representing our country […]...
